$comment: Upstream sources of the phive-rules validation artefacts: where each rule set family is published and how a new version can be detected. Update 'current' in the same commit that adds a new version.

$comment-fields.coordinates: DVR group ID and artefact IDs covered by this entry
$comment-fields.check: how to detect updates: web-page (fetch url, compare version/date shown) | github-release | github-commits (commits on a path, no releases/tags) | gitlab-tree (GitLab tree API listing of release files) | file-hash (download a fixed URL, compare hash/content) | manual (email, issue attachment, ...) | none (frozen upstream)
$comment-fields.url: where the current version is published
$comment-fields.url-status: verified (fetched on last-checked) | in-repo (found in repo, not verified) | broken (not reachable/404/403) | unknown
$comment-fields.current: newest non-deprecated version in this repo (DVR version)
$comment-fields.current-upstream: upstream name of that version, if it differs from current
$comment-fields.upstream-latest: latest version seen upstream on last-checked
$comment-fields.last-checked: date of the last upstream check
$comment-fields.detect: what exactly to compare (only if non-obvious)
$comment-fields.notes: anything the checker or maintainer needs to know; open questions start with QUESTION:
